newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metals weaken on mixed interest.
newsitem.headline: Indian metals weaken on mixed interest.

text.p: Indian metals' prices, barring zinc, weakened on Thursday, dealers said.

Zinc rose on reports that state-owned Hindustan Zinc had raised selling prices by 300 rupees per tonne for January, they said. Ready zinc rose by 50 rupees to 6,450 rupees per quintal. Lead prices on the other hand fell by 50 rupees to 4,400 rupees.
Copper lost 100 rupees at 12,350 rupees on less demand and light profit-taking. It rose by 100 rupees on Wednesday.

Nickel slumped by 300 rupees to 36,200 rupees on higher arrivals of imported metals coupled with weak world market trends. Aluminium slid by 50 rupees to 7,200 rupees amid sluggish physical buying while tin was quiet at 34,300 rupees.
